title: rookie_starters
description: R45 (owner's pick: facts only, never invented points): rookies (roster years_exp == 0) listed at pos_rank 1 in the LATEST nflverse depth-chart snapshot, with team schedule FACTS (SOS on the app's 1..5 scale, bye week). Deliberately carries NO projection field of any kind - a rookie's points stay absent until real 2026 usage exists.

snapshot_utc.description: The depth-chart snapshot (dt) these listings come from.

role_unsettled.description: true for RBs (owner rule): a listed RB1 is a depth-chart fact, not a workload claim - committee/handcuff territory.

sos.description: Team strength-of-schedule on the same 1..5 scale the player cards use; null when opponents are unrated (unknown, never 3.0).
